  - Dark wood vertical slat feature wall behind bed — bedroom: HDB: allowed, no permit. carpentry fixed to walls (wardrobes, feature walls, solid timber/mirror wall panels, shelves) (HDB-CARPENTRY, https://www.hdb.gov.sg/managing-my-home/renovation-and-maintenance/renovation/renovation-guidelines/building-works).       - Pending verification: Household shelter: see HDB-HS
      Pending: this work is not cleared to proceed.

items.description: Deep three-seater olive green linen sofa with loose cushions and low dark base
Modular tufted green velvet sectional sofa with chunky rounded low-profile cushions
Oval walnut nesting coffee tables with splayed solid wood legs
Plush cream high-pile shaggy area rug
Round chunky-knit grey-white floor pouf
Large white matte half-dome pendant light
Slim black metal square frame side tables, set of two
Brass mushroom dome table lamp with slim stem
Round woven seagrass floor cushion, low flat zafu-style seat
Long low rustic reclaimed wood tea table with cut-out trestle legs
Low upholstered beige platform bed with rounded edges and curved headboard
Dark wood vertical slat feature wall behind bed

routes.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. New bathroom floor finishes may be laid over the existing ones using adhesive, also during the 3-year restriction. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
routes.route: Overlay: any time, including the first 3 years
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)

conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of finishes and screed at most 50mm

items.description: Modular low sofa with plush tufted cushions in moss green fabric
Oval solid walnut nesting coffee table with splayed tapered legs
Cream shaggy high-pile wool area rug, soft plush texture
Oversized white dome pendant light with matte finish
Round chunky knit grey-white pouf floor cushion
Slim square black metal frame side table, tall open plant stand style
Brass dome table lamp with slim stem and mushroom shade
Long low reclaimed wood console bench with rustic plank top
Low upholstered platform bed with rounded edges and curved headboard in beige fabric
Dark walnut vertical slat timber feature wall behind bed headboard
Sage green rounded bean bag lounge chair, slouchy soft form
Slim black metal task floor lamp with angled conical shade

conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of finishes and screed at most 50mm

options.reason: Pending: confirm the new finish including adhesive thickness; HDB permits at most 13mm. New bathroom floor finishes may be laid over the existing ones using adhesive, also during the 3-year restriction. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.

conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)

Pending verification: No tampering with the floor trap

conditions: Pending verification: Fasteners at most 6mm diameter and 40mm penetration depth

routes.route: Overlay: laying parquet/timber/laminate/bamboo over existing finishes
conditions: Pending verification: No raising the floor as a platform

routes.route: Overlay: laying over existing floor finishes with adhesive only
conditions: Pending verification: Only 1 existing layer of floor finishes (including cement screed)

routes.reason: Replacing existing floor finishes needs an HDB permit. Subject to verification of the remaining HDB conditions.
routes.route: Replace: hacking out and replacing existing floor finishes (ceramic, homogeneous, terrazzo, marble, parquet/timber, other tiles)
conditions: Pending verification: Total thickness of floor finishes and screed at most 50mm
Pending verification: Wet areas: pre-packed waterproofing screed; membrane upturned at least 150mm in bathrooms, and around sanitary stacks (400mm radius) in kitchen/open balcony
Pending verification: UPVC floor trap grating with long collar
Pending verification: Pre-packed screed in dry areas
Pending verification: Gas pipes must not be embedded in the screed or finishes
routes.alternative: Overlay with adhesive (HDB-FLOOR-OVERLAY) or vinyl (HDB-FLOOR-VINYL) needs no permit.

routes.reason: Raising the floor level with concrete beyond 50mm (including finishes) is not allowed; topping up with lightweight screed in a balcony, kitchen or bathroom needs a permit.
routes.route: Raise: raising the floor level
conditions: Pending verification: Lightweight top-up: non-combustible in-fill, existing finishes and screed removed, total load at most 120kg/m2, parapet/window sill at least 1000mm above the finished floor

items.description: Modular low sofa with plump tufted cushions in moss green fabric
Nesting oval walnut coffee table set with splayed solid wood legs
Low platform bed with rounded upholstered beige frame and curved headboard
Dark wood vertical slat feature wall panelling behind the bed
Large white dome pendant light with oversized matte half-sphere shade
Plush cream high-pile shaggy area rug with soft texture
Long low rustic reclaimed wood tea bench with carved circular leg cut-outs
Round woven seagrass floor cushion pouf, low natural straw zafu seat
Slim black metal task floor lamp with angled cone shade on tripod base
Slim black metal wireframe square side table, tall open cube nesting pair
Brass dome table lamp with slim stem and round base
Warm mid-brown wood plank flooring with natural grain and matte finish

items.description: Modular low sofa with deep cushions, olive green fabric, tufted plush seats
Nesting oval walnut coffee tables with splayed solid wood legs
Plush shaggy cream high-pile area rug
Large white matte dome pendant light, oversized minimalist shade
Slim square black metal frame side table, tall open-frame plant stand
Brass table lamp with dome mushroom shade and slender stem
Slim black metal task floor lamp with angled cone shade
Round woven seagrass floor cushion pouf, low natural straw zafu seat
Long low rustic reclaimed wood console bench with circular cutout end panels
Low upholstered beige platform bed with rounded headboard and wide padded base
Dark wood vertical slat feature wall behind bed headboard
Warm mid-brown wood plank flooring with natural grain
